description: The file is a shell script used for testing Git checkout handling of ambiguous refs (branches and tags). It sets up test repositories and verifies behavior of checkout commands with ambiguous references, including warnings, switch behaviors, and output messages.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files for test setup.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks for specific pattern matches in output streams.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for further tests based on previous success.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
